#### Final Report

**CRITERION: `_wrap_title` and `_pack_tags` measure width in terminal cells (`rich.cells.cell_len`), not code points, so CJK/emoji titles and tags wrap where they actually paint — MET — evidence: `src/no_human/cli/shell_lanes.py:217` (`_cells`), `:312` (`_wrap_title` calls `_cell_wrap`), `:335` (`_pack_tags` uses `cell_len`); repro: `tests/test_cli_shell_model.py::test_a_double_width_title_is_measured_in_cells_not_code_points` and `::test_a_double_width_tag_is_measured_in_cells` fail against the pre-fix code (`AssertionError: 67 <= 40`, `assert cell_len... <= 40` false) and pass against the fix (`uv run pytest tests/test_cli_shell_model.py -q` → `70 passed`).**

**CRITERION: below a 23-cell pane (`avail < 10`), wrap on bare pane width dropping the indent instead of bailing out to Textual's own ugly column-0 wrap; the 23-cell threshold is pinned by a test — MET — evidence: `src/no_human/cli/shell_lanes.py:275` (`_layout`, `avail >= 10` vs `width >= 2` branches), `:371` (`_task_lines` narrow branch); pinned by `tests/test_cli_shell_model.py::test_a_pane_narrower_than_the_title_column_still_wraps` (widths 10/15/20, asserts no 13-cell indent and no bail-out) and `::test_below_two_cells_wrapping_is_left_to_textual`; repro: the narrow-pane test fails on unfixed code (`43 <= 20` etc., confirmed via git-free revert) and passes on the fix.**

**CRITERION: lane empty hints run through the same wrapper so a long hint (43 cells) cannot overflow a narrow pane — MET — evidence: `src/no_human/cli/shell_lanes.py:424` (`_empty_hint_lines`), wired into `render_lanes` in place of the old unwrapped `lines.append(...)`; `tests/test_cli_shell_model.py::test_an_empty_lane_hint_is_wrapped_to_the_pane` (widths 36 and 20) and `::test_without_a_width_the_empty_hint_is_the_single_line_it_always_was`; repro: fails on unfixed code (`43 <= 36` false) and passes on the fix.**

**CRITERION: nothing visible today was removed or reworded, and no existing test was weakened — MET — evidence: `src/no_human/cli/shell_lanes.py`'s wide-mode (`>=23`) path is untouched byte-for-byte; all 63 pre-existing tests in `test_cli_shell_model.py` and all 53 pre-existing tests in `test_cli_shell_app.py` remain unmodified and pass; full suite `unset VIRTUAL_ENV && uv run pytest -q -n 4` → `9380 passed, 199 skipped, 16 warnings in 468.26s` (warnings are pre-existing `aiosqlite`/asyncio teardown noise in `tests/test_slack_intake.py`, unrelated to this change).**

**CRITERION: verified over the OUTER `widget.region` (not `size.width`), asserting every row ends in the padding cell — MET — evidence: `tests/test_cli_shell_app.py:270` `_lanes_rows` reads `lanes.render_lines(Region(0,0,lanes.region.width,...))`; new test `test_no_lanes_row_overflows_the_pane_at_a_narrow_terminal` (`:318`) resizes to drive `lanes.region.width < 23`, asserts `cell_len(row) == width` and `row.endswith(" ")` for every row — `2 passed` in the targeted run, `55 passed` for the full app-test file.**

**CRITERION: bugfix protocol — failing test written first, root-caused, fix verified against a reproduced failure, scoped tests run with full output — MET — evidence: git-free revert/restore cycle (backup via `cp`, mechanical revert via `/tmp/revert.py`+`/tmp/revert2.py`, no git commands used) showed `4 failed, 66 passed` on `tests/test_cli_shell_model.py` against unfixed code (exact residual-targeting failures), and `test_a_double_width_title_still_renders_correctly_at_the_app_level` failed on unfixed code with `assert block` (Textual's own wrap broke the title-column alignment invariant — the exact defect); restored fix → `125 passed` on `tests/test_cli_shell_model.py tests/test_cli_shell_app.py -q`.**
